title: An Octopus With No Armor Pretends to Be a Sea Snake
subject: mimic octopus

scenes.text: No armor, no shell. This octopus survives by pretending to be other animals.
It was discovered in 1998 off Sulawesi, Indonesia, and it is only about two feet long.
It can impersonate a lionfish, a sea snake, a jellyfish, even a crab.
Some reports count 15 different animals it copies, that we know of.
And it may choose its costume by who is attacking. When damselfish bully it, it becomes a sea snake, their predator.
Scientists suggest it picks the disguise its attacker fears most. No armor needed, just the right costume.

description:
An octopus with no armor survives by pretending to be other animals.
The mimic octopus, discovered off Indonesia in 1998, can copy lionfish, sea snakes and more, and may pick the disguise its attacker fears.
Which disguise would you pick?
first_comment: Which animal should it impersonate next? Which master of disguise should we cover?
